text:
alex_support: heads-up — customer on prod reported duplicate billing events after upgrading to our python SDK. they say some requests are retried and end up charged twice. :warning:

maria_eng: can you paste their SDK version + a minimal repro? any logs showing 2xx followed by retry?

alex_support: they sent this: pip freeze -> redwood-sdk==1.26.0, python 3.11. logs show request returns 200, then a retry kicks and we see a second successful call. snippet from their logs:

```
INFO 2026-03-05 14:02:11 request id=abc123 status=200 body="{...}"
INFO 2026-03-05 14:02:11 retrying request id=abc123 attempt=2 reason="refresh token returned 200"
INFO 2026-03-05 14:02:11 request id=abc123 status=200 body="{...}"
```

alex_support: repro steps they gave (condensed):
1) upgrade to redwood-sdk==1.26.0
2) long-running request uses built-in token refresh in SDK
3) if refresh overlaps with response path, retry layer issues duplicate attempt

liam_sre: interesting. are they using idempotency keys? if not, our retries can cause duplicate side-effect calls. 1.26 changed retry/idempotency behavior — need to confirm defaults.

tony_backend: i dug into the 1.26 PRs — we changed default retry backoff and moved idempotency header management into the retry middleware. there was also a change that no longer auto-injects Idempotency-Key for non-idempotent routes unless retry middleware wraps the call. edge-case when refresh token flow triggers a retry after a 2xx is seen.

maria_eng: can they work around right now?

tony_backend: short-term workarounds:
- pin to redwood-sdk==1.25.3 (known-safe behavior)
- explicitly set idempotency header on calls that must be single-run: `headers={"Idempotency-Key": uuid4().hex}`
- disable sdk retries: `Client(..., retries=0)` or set env `REDWOOD_RETRIES=0` so refresh still happens but retry layer won't reissue requests.

alex_support: asked customer to pin to 1.25.3 and provide confirmation; they want a less manual fix. they're seeing ~200 duplicated charges across last 12 hours. billing team alerted.

liam_sre: this is P0 billing impact. can we push emergency rollback or patch?

tony_backend: next steps from infra/eng: 1) create a hotfix release 1.26.1 to ensure idempotency header is injected prior to any retry decisions during token refresh path. 2) add a safeguard: if response status >=200 and <300, do not replay request on refresh path. 3) publish advisory and recommended pin.

maria_eng: i can draft the advisory + support KB with repro steps and recommended pin. include code example for adding idempotency header:```
from uuid import uuid4
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(prompt, headers={"Idempotency-Key": uuid4().hex})
```

alex_support: customer confirmed pin to 1.25.3 reduces duplicates immediately. handing billing contact to finance. they asked for ETA on patch.

tony_backend: aiming for a hotfix in next 3 hours, canary rollback if needed. deploy-bot: initiating canary rollback to 1.25.3 for affected pool now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rolling back service-group `api-prod-inference` to redwood-sdk=1.25.3 in region us-west-2 (canary started)

liam_sre: thanks. also put a constraint in release notes to call out the retry/idempotency change so customers can preemptively pin.

maria_eng: adding action items: publish advisory, open billing incident ticket with finance, ship 1.26.1 hotfix, add e2e test covering token refresh + retry path.

alex_support: will escalate to account execs and keep customer updated. closing loop once hotfix shipped and billing reconciled. :thumbsup:
